title: The Ledger of Unspoken Things
setting_summary: A cliffside archive-city called Vellum, where every citizen's spoken words are tallied by a vast bureaucratic Order and silence is the only untaxed currency. Residents live in narrow terraced cells stacked above the sea, and each dawn they must declare their grievances aloud to a listening clerk or forfeit their ration of light. The archive's founding charter claims that all voices are equal, yet the Ledger quietly records whose words are heard and whose are erased.
